headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Opus 5, Aiming for Fable 5-Class Intelligence at Half the Price
what_happened: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, priced the same as predecessor Opus 4.8 ($5/$25 per million input/output tokens). Anthropic positions it as approaching flagship Fable 5's capability at half the per-task cost, citing strength in coding, scientific research, and iterative problem-solving. It's available immediately via the Claude API, Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork, with an optional faster mode at double price.
why_it_matters: Opus 5 gives Anthropic a mid-tier flagship that, per its own benchmarks, roughly doubles Opus 4.8's coding score and nearly matches pricier Fable 5 at half the cost -- sharpening price/performance competition among frontier labs, though Anthropic says it still trails its own Mythos 5 on cybersecurity tasks.
one_liner: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's newest AI model, built to think through hard coding and science problems nearly as well as a pricier model, but for about half the cost.
